sources.fixturePath: sheets/amfi/31 AĞUSTOS -4 EYLÜL 2026 Amfi programı.xlsx
sources.notes: Weekly companion, and the only source whose document is republished rather than edited in place (ADR-133). The faculty drops one Google Sheets workbook per week into the Drive folder named by discoveryFolderId, which is linked from ogrenci-istanbultip.istanbul.edu.tr; the folder is the stable address and the file is not. Each poll resolves the folder to the most recently changed workbook in it and acquires that; externalId is the workbook this catalog entry was written against and is what a cycle falls back to when the folder cannot be listed, so it is configuration and is never rewritten by discovery. No worksheet gid is pinned: a gid belongs to one workbook and next week's is a different file. Acquisition reads the whole workbook and every date the parser reports comes from a day title row, because the workbook keeps the previous week as an extra worksheet and its tab titles are unreliable. classYear and programLanguage are nominal - the document covers every class year and both programs, and as a companion it publishes nothing, so its own source context is never used to publish.
